continuity.arc_goal: Implement linked workflows MVP and post-MVP link lifecycle management: parent-to-child workflow links with completion blocking, cross-partition cancellation, observable state graphs, bidirectional link records, purge guard for linked children, and link garbage collection on purge/clear state.

progress_update.summary: We designed bidirectional link records for link GC. The link table now stores both outgoing (parent→child) and incoming (child→parent) records using a LinkDirection enum. Incoming records are written when the child's partition processes AttachInvocation with a Link sink. Key collision prevents cyclic graphs. Purge guard rejects purge while incoming links exist. RemoveParentLink cross-partition notification removes incoming records when parent purges/unlinks. Wrote a failing TDD test for the full lifecycle. Task breakdown complete, ready for implementation.
progress_update.goal: Implement linked workflows MVP and post-MVP link lifecycle: completion blocking, cross-partition cancellation, cancellation propagation, link removal, and link lifecycle management (bidirectional records, purge guard, GC on purge/clear state).

constraints: Single link table (b'lk' prefix) for both directions — direction stored as field, not in key
Key collision (local, remote) prevents cyclic graphs — both directions can't coexist for same pair
LinkState only meaningful for LinkDirection::Parent records
Incoming link written when child's partition processes AttachInvocation with Link sink
Cross-partition links from day one — all link operations use outbox messages
Only workflows can enter Completing — VOs complete immediately regardless of links
Links keyed by (parent_service_id, child_service_id) — no label, no child_invocation_id
decisions: LinkDirection::Parent/Child enum instead of bool — clearer semantics
local_service_id/remote_service_id field names — direction determines which is parent vs child
has_parent_links instead of has_incoming_links — domain vocabulary over graph theory
Command::RemoveParentLink — describes the action from receiver's perspective
No parent_service_ids on CompletedInvocation — incoming link records serve the same purpose
Removed label field entirely — links identified by child_service_id, not arbitrary label string
Extracted cancel_linked_children helper used by cancel (Invoked/Suspended/Paused + Completing) and kill (Completing)
Link barrier check moved outside sinks/retention guard — workflows always enter Completing with running links
No active_children_count — query link table for Running links instead of maintaining denormalized counter
Completion delivers Result<T, E> only — no status field, no inline frozen graph
Completing variant carries InFlightInvocationMetadata + buffered ResponseResult
RemoveLink included in MVP — graph curation is load-bearing
End-to-end integration test included in MVP scope
Cancellation is local per node — each node cancels its own direct children
